pr_title: fix(nuxt): improve handling of redirects within middleware
pr_body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

resolves https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/issues/19557, https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/issues/20038
closes https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/issues/20080

closes https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/19999

### ❓ Type of change
- [ ] 📖 Documentation (updates to the documentation or readme)
- [x] 🐞 Bug fix (a non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] 👌 Enhancement (improving an existing functionality like performance)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (a non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 🧹 Chore (updates to the build process or auxiliary tools and libraries)
- [ ] ⚠️ Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

### 📚 Description

This reworks the handling of redirects within middleware in Nuxt 3. We're no longer doing any hacks by setting the response status code and reading it later on . Instead:

1. we directly and immediately redirect to external URLs as soon as they are encountered.
2. for internal redirections, we add a navigation guard to the end of the stack and directly perform the redirect at the end of the middleware chain, giving a chance for another middleware to redirect further.

In both cases, we abort the navigation and skip sending additional redirections or 404 responses in this case. We also avoid (in the nitro renderer) trying to send a payload or JSON or HTML response if a redirection response has already been sent from vue-router middleware.

### 📝 Checklist

- [x] I have linked an issue or discussion.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.

issue_context.title: Script unnecessarily executed on redirect
issue_context.body: ### Environment - Operating System: `Linux` - Node Version: `v16.14.2` - Nuxt Version: `3.3.3` - Nitro Version: `2.3.2` - Package Manager: `npm@7.17.0` - Builder: `vite` - User Config: `-` - Runtime Modules: `-` - Build Modules: `-` ### Reproduction https://stackblitz.com/edit/github-7moc1e ``` $ npm i $ npm run dev ``` ### Describe the bug I'm not sure if it's a bug or a specification, so I will report it as a bug for now. Page script is executed twice when redirecting. For example, let's say you have a simple page component like below. A component that just outputs a console when created and onserver. ```vue ``` Next, the middleware that redirects when there is a `redirect=1` in url query. ```ts export default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware(async (to, from) => { if (to.query.redirect) { console.log('redirect'); return navigateTo({ ...to, query: { ...to.query, redirect: undefined } }); } }); ``` At this time, if I access `/?redirect=1`, Page script will be executed twice as below. in console ``` redirect created onServerPrefetch created onServerPrefetch ``` I think it is desirable not to execute the script of the page that before being redirected when redirecting. What do you think? ### Additional context _No response_ ### Logs _No response_

Is it Nuxt2?

review_comments: This really shouldn't have happened to end the response in middle of rendering and just retuning non value. Nitro wrapper needs to be more predictable for caching. We might instead throw an error code (like ERR_REDIRECT) inside the app and handle in wrapper that something happened.

Can you explain more about what you mean about being predictable for caching? Are you imagining we'll cache redirects, or ideally return a `RenderResponse` which has a null body but statusCode/message/headers matching redirect?

The current behaviour, before this PR, was to directly send a redirect, so this isn't an issue introduced by this PR; we're just fixing an issue where _both_ redirect _and_ a `RenderResponse` were returned. I'm very happy to do a further refactor of how redirects work, either (within this PR) in time for the patch release today or subsequently.
Surely we can delay this improvement to later and nitro renderer is _currently_ working nice with this implicit ending.

Just to be clear, I am very happy to rework the way redirects work! Just wanting to make sure we are aligned on how that happens.

Will merge this but hopefully create new PR reworking it shortly - might need to DM you to discuss.
